description:
Fetch detailed data on a national sovereign AI compute program.
Returns: announced_usd, announced_govt_only_usd, committed_usd, disbursed_usd, reality_ratio, status, key_partners, NVIDIA/US dependency, source_count, and published_spending (a government's own spending figures, each in its currency against its budget, with the document).
'list_all' returns a summary table of all tracked programs.

announced_usd can include private commitments; announced_govt_only_usd records the government-funded portion. Compare the programme sources for scope, dates and currency conversions. A government-only figure can still span a different budget period or initiative from another programme's figure.
reality_ratio divides disbursed_usd by announced_govt_only_usd, using announced_usd when the government-only field is null. The ratio is null when disbursement or the denominator is missing, or the denominator is zero. Each row includes reality_ratio_denominator_usd and reality_ratio_denominator_field so the division is reproducible from the payload. Where disbursed_usd converts a government's published spending figure, reality_ratio_basis is native_currency and the ratio divides that figure by its own budget in the source currency (reality_ratio_numerator_native / reality_ratio_denominator_native, in reality_ratio_currency): the two dollar amounts were converted on different dates and do not reproduce it.
disbursed_usd derives only from a government's published expenditure or payments; a transfer to an administering body is listed in published_spending as released and is not counted. Missing fields and differing reporting scopes limit comparisons; reality_ratio_unavailable_reason explains an absent ratio.

list_all.description: Return summary of all sovereign programs instead of a single record

program_id.description: Scrutica sovereign-program ID in the form 'sovereign-<country_code>' (e.g. 'sovereign-ae'), as returned by scrutica_search and list_all. The bare country_code is also accepted. Regional programs use non-ISO codes ('sovereign-eurohpc', 'sovereign-nato-aukus', 'sovereign-africa-regional') and are reachable ONLY via program_id or list_all — the 2-letter country parameter cannot match them.

name: scrutica_get_sovereign_program
